title: An Energy-Based Mechanism for Compositional Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2512.04745v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Flexible intelligence relies on the ability to reuse previously acquired behaviors and combine them differently as circumstances change. In biological and artificial systems, this ability is often attributed to gating mechanisms that determine how much each available behavior should contribute at a given time. Yet these gating rules, the dynamics that compute them, and the neural circuits that may implement them are usually introduced separately, leaving unclear whether they reflect a common underlying principle. Here, we show that they can all be derived from a single variational principle for behavioral composition. The resulting mechanism naturally gives rise to softmax gating, evolves as an energy-based dynamical system with guaranteed convergence, and admits a recurrent neural network instantiation featuring context-dependent and local interactions. translated_title: 一种用于组合行为的基于能量的机制
translated_abstract: 灵活的智能依赖于重复使用先前习得的行为，并随着环境变化以不同方式将它们组合起来的能力。在生物系统与人工系统中，这种能力通常被归因于门控机制，即决定每种可用行为在特定时刻应贡献多少的机制。然而，这些门控规则、计算它们的动力学过程，以及可能实现它们的神经回路，通常是被分别引入的，因此尚不清楚它们是否反映了某种共同的底层原理。在本研究中，我们证明它们都可以从单一的“行为组合变分原理”中推导出来。由此产生的机制自然地产生了softmax门控，其演化表现为一个具有收敛性保证的基于能量的动力学系统，并且可以由一个具有情境依赖性和局部交互特性的循环神经网络实例来实现。在集体行为、人类决策和分层控制等多个领域中，该……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的行为组合变分原理，从中可同时推导出softmax门控规则、保证收敛的基于能量的动力学系统，以及具有局部与情境依赖交互的循环神经网络实现。
en_tdlr: This paper derives softmax gating, energy-based dynamics with guaranteed convergence, and recurrent neural network implementations from a single variational principle for compositional behavior.
